claims.text: Many reviewers say the mask leaves skin feeling clean, smooth, tight, and brightened, with several comparing results to a professional facial.
A strong, unpleasant smell is the most commonly mentioned drawback, with some reviewers finding it nauseating and others noting it lingers even with essential oils added.
Several reviewers praise the natural, high-quality ingredients and consider the product a good value.
A few reviewers report disappointment, saying the product did not improve their complexion or perform as stated, and some find it messy or difficult to use.
Some reviewers note redness or irritation after use, especially with a thick layer, though they mention the product warns about this.
